This implies that investors are valuing the company at a much more attractive level compared to its peers, suggesting undervaluation. Secondly, while the return on equity (ROE) over the last three years stands at 8.97%, which is lower than the sector benchmark of 17.48% [E26], E29 shows that the company has maintained a median ROE of 10% over the past year, indicating resilience and potential for improvement. Moreover, JSWSTEEL's return on assets (ROA) at 10.38% is notably higher than the sector benchmark of 2.03% [E8], suggesting efficient asset utilization and strong operational performance relative to its competitors. However, this should be viewed in context with the other positive indicators and historical performance metrics provided.
